title: Design System: 灵山胜境 AI 数字人导游

display.purpose: Content page titles and scenic spot names. Serif only for content display surfaces.

body.purpose: All body text, interactive UI, labels, and chat messages. System sans-serif stack.

label.purpose: Tags, badges, subtitles, metadata. Small size with slight letter-spacing.

shadows.name: ambient-sm
shadows.purpose: Legacy low-elevation cards in interactive layer.

shadows.name: glass-rest
shadows.purpose: Liquid glass card at rest. Dual-layer warm shadow + inset highlight for refraction.

shadows.name: glass-hover
shadows.purpose: Liquid glass card on hover. Deepened shadow + brightened border + translateY(-4px).

shadows.name: panel-mobile
shadows.purpose: Bottom-sheet detail panel on mobile. Shadow direction upward.

shadows.name: btn-primary
shadows.purpose: Primary button glow. Gold-tinted, color-matched to the button background.

motion.name: ease-expo-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for card hover, entrance, panel transitions. Expo-out: quick start, gentle settle.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Simple transitions: page enter, overlay fade, tab color.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Micro-interactions: tag hover, button state change.

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: Standard transitions: card hover, panel open.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Entrance animations: card stagger in, image zoom on hover.

motion.name: stagger-step
motion.purpose: Per-card stagger delay for grid entrance animation.

breakpoints.name: desktop-min
breakpoints.purpose: Sidebar navigation + wide content grids activate.

breakpoints.name: tablet-max
breakpoints.purpose: Card grid reduces from 3 to 2 columns, detail panel narrows to 520px.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA: gold gradient pill button. Used for primary actions across all pages.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #c8963e, #a0722a); color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 28px; padding: 14px 32px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(200, 150, 62, 0.30); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(200, 150, 62, 0.30); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action: warm grey outline button. Used alongside primary or for less critical actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #f5f1eb; color: #3d3630; border: 1px solid #e8e3db; border-radius: 28px; padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #ede7dd; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.css: .ds-detail-panel { position: relative; width: 100%; max-height: 82vh; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.68); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(150%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(150%); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.55); border-radius: 22px 22px 0 0; box-shadow: 0 -4px 32px rgba(44,41,38,0.10), 0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.50), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.55); overflow-y: auto; } .ds-detail-img { width: 100%; height: 200px; object-fit: cover; display: block; } .ds-detail-body { padding: 18px 20px 24px; } .ds-detail-name { font-family: 'Noto Serif SC', 'Songti SC', serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; color: #2c2926; letter-spacing: 0.02em; margin: 0; } .ds-detail-sub { font-size: 13px; color: #9b8465; font-weight: 500; margin-top: 2px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; } .ds-detail-desc { font-size: 14px; color: #2c2926; line-height: 1.8; margin-top: 14px; text-align: justify; } .ds-detail-info { margin-top: 14px; padding: 12px 14px; background: rgba(155,132,101,0.06); border-radius: 12px; border-left: 3px solid #9b8465; font-size: 12.5px; color: #8a8680; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-detail-actions { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-top: 16px; } .ds-detail-btn { flex: 1; padding: 12px; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(155,132,101,0.25); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px); color: #2c2926; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; transition: all 0.25s; } .ds-detail-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); border-color: rgba(155,132,101,0.40); } .ds-detail-btn-primary { background: rgba(155,132,101,0.15); border-color: rgba(155,132,101,0.35); color: #7a6748; font-weight: 600; } .ds-detail-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(155,132,101,0.22); }

narrative.overview:
灵山胜境数字人导游的设计语言源于无锡灵山景区的材质本真：琉璃的通透、古铜的温润、素绢的柔和。系统以暖金（真金）和青绿（琉璃青）为主品牌色，构建一个既庄严又亲切的佛教文化旅游数字体验。

系统采用双材质策略：交互层（导航、按钮、表单）使用暖色平面语言，强调可识别性和触达效率；内容展示层（景点卡片、详情面板）引入液态玻璃材质——半透明白底 + backdrop-blur + 内高光边缘——营造"透过琉璃看灵山"的视觉联想。两种材质共享同一套色彩和间距基础，在真金色作为统一线索下自然过渡。

整体气质：温润克制，留白从容。移动端为 480px 居中的单列 App 壳，桌面端通过 92px 侧栏导航扩展为宽屏内容网格。所有动画使用 expo-out 缓动曲线，不做弹跳和过度表现。
keyCharacteristics: 暖金/青绿双主色，源自灵山景区的琉璃、古铜、素绢材质
双材质系统：平面交互层 + 液态玻璃内容层，各司其职
移动优先 480px 壳，桌面 ≥900px 侧栏自适应
投影全为暖色调（墨炭基底），拒绝纯黑阴影
expo-out 缓动主导，prefers-reduced-motion 完全降级

rules.name: The One Gold Rule
rules.body: 真金色在一屏内出现的面积不超过 10%。它用于激活态和关键 CTA，不是装饰色。大面积金色会让庄严感滑向浮华。

rules.name: The Two-Theme Transition Rule
rules.body: 从平面交互层进入液态玻璃内容层时，真金让位给古铜，素绢让位给石灰。两个子系统的色彩温差不超过 5%（都是暖调基底），过渡自然不突兀。

rules.name: The Serif-for-Content Rule
rules.body: 衬线体仅用于内容展示页面的标题和景点名称。导航、按钮、表单、标签、对话消息全部使用无衬线体。系统级 UI 不用衬线。

rules.name: The Tinted-Shadow Rule
rules.body: 所有投影使用墨炭（#3d3630 或 #2c2926）的 rgba，绝不用纯黑。投影色调与页面基底保持一致。

rules.name: The One-Surface One-Depth Rule
rules.body: 同一表面类型不混用两种深度表达。玻璃卡片只用玻璃投影，平面卡片只用 ambient 投影。从不在玻璃卡片上加 ambient 阴影。

rules.name: The Two-Radius Rule
rules.body: 交互层（按钮、导航、表单）使用 8-14px 圆角家族；内容展示层（玻璃卡片、详情面板）使用 20-22px 圆角家族。同一页面内不跨家族混用。

dos: Do 在所有投影中使用暖色墨炭 rgba（#3d3630 或 #2c2926），不用纯黑
Do 衬线体仅用于内容展示标题，交互 UI 全用无衬线
Do 每个表面类型只使用一种深度表达方式
Do 真金色在一屏内保持 10% 以下面积
Do 过渡动画使用 cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) expo-out
Do 内容层使用玻璃材质（blur + 半透明 + 内高光）时，页面背景必须有柔光渐变来衬托
donts: Don't 在玻璃卡片上叠加 ambient 投影
Don't 用高饱和度色（> 80% saturation）作为大面积背景或主色
Don't 在非内容展示页使用衬线体
Don't 用纯黑 #000000 或纯白 #ffffff 作为大面积底色
Don't 混合使用两套圆角家族（交互层 8-14px 和内容层 20-22px 不在同一页面混用）
Don't 忽略 prefers-reduced-motion——所有动画必须有降级路径
